texts.NIV84: The king's heart is in the hand of the LORD; he directs it like a watercourse wherever he pleases.
texts.KJV: The king's heart is in the hand of the Lord, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.
texts.DRB: As the divisions of waters, so the heart of the king is in the hand of the Lord: whithersoever he will he shall turn it.

texts.NIV84: All a man's ways seem right to him, but the LORD weighs the heart.
texts.KJV: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes: but the Lord pondereth the hearts.
texts.NKJV:
Every way of a man is right in his own eyes,
But the Lord weighs the hearts.
texts.DRB: Every way of a man seemeth right to himself: but the Lord weigheth the hearts.

texts.NIV84: To do what is right and just is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.
texts.KJV: To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the Lord than sacrifice.
texts.NKJV:
To do righteousness and justice
Is more acceptable to the Lord than sacrifice.
texts.DRB: To do mercy and judgment, pleaseth the Lord more than victims.

texts.NIV84: Haughty eyes and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, are sin!
texts.KJV: An high look, and a proud heart, and the plowing of the wicked, is sin.
texts.NKJV:
A haughty look, a proud heart,
And the plowing of the wicked are sin.
texts.DRB: Haughtiness of the eyes is the enlarging of the heart: the lamp of the wicked is sin.

texts.NIV84: The plans of the diligent lead to profit as surely as haste leads to poverty.
texts.KJV: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; but of every one that is hasty only to want.
texts.NKJV:
The plans of the diligent lead surely to plenty,
But those of everyone who is hasty, surely to poverty.
texts.DRB: The thoughts of the industrious al- ways bring forth abundance: but every sluggard is always in want.

blocks.title: A Lying Tongue & The Soul of The Wicked

texts.NIV84: A fortune made by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor and a deadly snare.
texts.KJV: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death.
texts.NKJV:
Getting treasures by a lying tongue
Is the fleeting fantasy of those who seek death.
texts.DRB: He that gathereth treasures by a lying tongue, is vain and foolish, and shall stumble upon the snares of death.

texts.NIV84: The violence of the wicked will drag them away, for they refuse to do what is right.
texts.KJV: The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse to do judgment.
texts.NKJV:
The violence of the wicked will destroy them,
Because they refuse to do justice.
texts.DRB: The robberies of the wicked shall be their downfall, because they would not do judgment.

texts.NIV84: The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.
texts.KJV: The way of man is froward and strange: but as for the pure, his work is right.
texts.NKJV:
The way of a guilty man is perverse;
But as for the pure, his work is right.
texts.DRB: The perverse way of a man is strange: but as for him that is pure, his work is right.

texts.NIV84: Better to live on a corner of the roof than share a house with a quarrelsome wife.
texts.KJV: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a wide house.
texts.NKJV:
Better to dwell in a corner of a housetop,
Than in a house shared with a contentious woman.
texts.DRB: It is better to sit in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling women, and in a common house.

texts.NIV84: The wicked man craves evil; his neighbor gets no mercy from him.
texts.KJV: The soul of the wicked desireth evil: his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes.
texts.NKJV:
The soul of the wicked desires evil;
His neighbor finds no favor in his eyes.
texts.DRB: The soul of the wicked desireth evil, he will not have pity on his neighbour.

texts.NIV84: When a mocker is punished, the simple gain wisdom; when a wise man is instructed, he gets knowledge.
texts.KJV: When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise: and when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.
texts.NKJV:
When the scoffer is punished, the simple is made wise;
But when the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.
texts.DRB: When a pestilent man is punished, the little one will be wiser: and if he follow the wise, he will receive knowledge.

texts.NIV84: The Righteous One takes note of the house of the wicked and brings the wicked to ruin.
texts.KJV: The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked: but God overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness.
texts.NKJV:
The righteous God wisely considers the house of the wicked,
Overthrowing the wicked for their wickedness.
texts.DRB: The just considereth seriously the house of the wicked, that he may withdraw the wicked from evil.

texts.NIV84: If a man shuts his ears to the cry of the poor, he too will cry out and not be answered.
texts.KJV: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard.
texts.NKJV:
Whoever shuts his ears to the cry of the poor
Will also cry himself and not be heard.
texts.DRB: He that stoppeth his ear against the cry of the poor, shall also cry himself and shall not be heard.

texts.NIV84: A gift given in secret soothes anger, and a bribe concealed in the cloak pacifies great wrath.
texts.KJV: A gift in secret pacifieth anger: and a reward in the bosom strong wrath.
texts.NKJV:
A gift in secret pacifies anger,
And a bribe behind the back, strong wrath.
texts.DRB: A secret present quencheth anger: and a gift in the bosom the greatest wrath.

texts.NIV84: When justice is done, it brings joy to the righteous but terror to evildoers.
texts.KJV: It is joy to the just to do judgment: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
texts.NKJV:
It is a joy for the just to do justice,
But destruction will come to the workers of iniquity.
texts.DRB: It is joy to the just to do judgment: and dread to them that work iniquity.

blocks.title: A Man Who Wanders from Understanding

texts.NIV84: A man who strays from the path of understanding comes to rest in the company of the dead.
texts.KJV: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead.
texts.NKJV:
A man who wanders from the way of understanding
Will rest in the assembly of the dead.
texts.DRB: A man that shall wander out of the way of doctrine, shall abide in the company of the giants.

texts.NIV84: He who loves pleasure will become poor; whoever loves wine and oil will never be rich.
texts.KJV: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man: he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.
texts.NKJV:
He who loves pleasure will be a poor man;
He who loves wine and oil will not be rich.
texts.DRB: He that loveth good cheer, shall be in want: he that loveth wine, and fat things, shall not be rich.

texts.NIV84: The wicked become a ransom for the righteous, and the unfaithful for the upright.
texts.KJV: The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous, and the transgressor for the upright.
texts.NKJV:
The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous,
And the unfaithful for the upright.
texts.DRB: The wicked is delivered up for the just: and the unjust for the righteous.

texts.NIV84: Better to live in a desert than with a quarrelsome and ill-tempered wife.
texts.KJV: It is better to dwell in the wilderness, than with a contentious and an angry woman.
texts.NKJV:
Better to dwell in the wilderness,
Than with a contentious and angry woman.
texts.DRB: It is better to dwell in a wilderness, than with a quarrelsome and passionate woman.

texts.NIV84: In the house of the wise are stores of choice food and oil, but a foolish man devours all he has.
texts.KJV: There is treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man spendeth it up.
texts.NKJV:
There is desirable treasure,
And oil in the dwelling of the wise,
But a foolish man squanders it.
texts.DRB: There is a treasure to be desired, and oil in the dwelling of the just: and the foolish man shall spend it.

texts.NIV84: He who pursues righteousness and love finds life, prosperity and honor.
texts.KJV: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life, righteousness, and honour.
texts.NKJV:
He who follows righteousness and mercy
Finds life, righteousness, and honor.
texts.DRB: He that followeth justice and mercy, shall find life, justice, and glory.

blocks.title: Whoever Guards His Mouth and Tongue

texts.NIV84: A wise man attacks the city of the mighty and pulls down the stronghold in which they trust.
texts.KJV: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, and casteth down the strength of the confidence thereof.
texts.NKJV:
A wise man scales the city of the mighty,
And brings down the trusted stronghold.
texts.DRB: The wise man hath scaled the city of the strong, and hath cast down the strength of the confidence thereof.

texts.NIV84: He who guards his mouth and his tongue keeps himself from calamity.
texts.KJV: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles.
texts.NKJV:
Whoever guards his mouth and tongue
Keeps his soul from troubles.
texts.DRB: He that keepeth his mouth and his tongue, keepeth his soul from distress.

texts.NIV84: The proud and arrogant man-"Mocker" is his name; he behaves with overweening pride.
texts.KJV: Proud and haughty scorner is his name, who dealeth in proud wrath.
texts.NKJV:
A proud and haughty man—“Scoffer” is his name;
He acts with arrogant pride.
texts.DRB: The proud and the arrogant is called ignorant, who in anger worketh pride.

texts.NIV84: The sluggard's craving will be the death of him, because his hands refuse to work.
texts.KJV: The desire of the slothful killeth him; for his hands refuse to labour.
texts.NKJV:
The desire of the lazy man kills him,
For his hands refuse to labor.
texts.DRB: Desires kill the slothful: for his hands have refused to work at all.

texts.NIV84: All day long he craves for more, but the righteous give without sparing.
texts.KJV: He coveteth greedily all the day long: but the righteous giveth and spareth not.
texts.NKJV:
He covets greedily all day long,
But the righteous gives and does not spare.
texts.DRB: He longeth and desireth all the day : but he that is just, will give, and will not cease.

texts.NIV84: The sacrifice of the wicked is detestable- how much more so when brought with evil intent!
texts.KJV: The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination: how much more, when he bringeth it with a wicked mind?
texts.NKJV:
The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination;
How much more when he brings it with wicked intent!
texts.DRB: The sacrifices of the wicked are abominable, because they are offered of wickedness.

texts.NIV84: A false witness will perish, and whoever listens to him will be destroyed forever.
texts.KJV: A false witness shall perish: but the man that heareth speaketh constantly.
texts.NKJV:
A false witness shall perish,
But the man who hears him will speak endlessly.
texts.DRB: A lying witness shall perish: an obedient man shall speak of victory.

texts.NIV84: A wicked man puts up a bold front, but an upright man gives thought to his ways.
texts.KJV: A wicked man hardeneth his face: but as for the upright, he directeth his way.
texts.NKJV:
A wicked man hardens his face,
But as for the upright, he establishes his way.
texts.DRB: The wicked man impudently hardeneth his face: but he that is righteous, correcteth his way.

texts.NIV84: There is no wisdom, no insight, no plan that can succeed against the LORD.
texts.KJV: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the Lord.
texts.NKJV:
There is no wisdom or understanding
Or counsel against the Lord.
texts.DRB: There is no wisdom, there is no prudence, there is no counsel against the Lord.

texts.NIV84: The horse is made ready for the day of battle, but victory rests with the LORD.
texts.KJV: The horse is prepared against the day of battle: but safety is of the Lord.
texts.NKJV:
The horse is prepared for the day of battle,
But deliverance is of the Lord.
texts.DRB: The horse is prepared for the day of battle: but the Lord giveth safety.
